title: Delos Data, which develops network chips and software to connect AI chips in a data center, raised $100M from Matrix, Playground, Socratic Partners, and others (Stephen Nellis/Reuters)
summary: Stephen Nellis / Reuters: Delos Data, which develops network chips and software to connect AI chips in a data center, raised $100M from Matrix, Playground, Socratic Partners, and others — Delos Data, a startup founded by veterans of Intel Corp (INTC.O), on Tuesday said it has raised $100 million to develop chips …
